把两个英文单词的尾字母进行拼接 hello world a.直接输出od b.hello的尾字母是o, world的尾字母是d,所以拼接起来是od

a是没有推理的 b是有推理的

模型本身就会推理,不需要人去教他们推理

let think step by step对模型推理是有用的.

first principle in ML:

  • directly optimize what we want!

what do we want to optimize here i. 定义目标 optimize the metric of measuring generation quality

ii. 计算梯度 examples: correctness for solving math problems, blue score for machine translation

iii. 反向传播 all the reset is to compute gradients and do backpropagation!
